`playback.mp4` is a browser-test-only media fixture from Web Platform Tests:
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/media-source/mp4/test.mp4

Upstream licensing: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/LICENSE.md
It is served only by Playwright's test request handler, never by SoraiX's application or production server.

`live.json` contains recorded catalogue responses for deterministic browser tests.
